method: Small, deliberately selected comparison of displayed likes and downloads on GDBrowser, plus the user's supplied forum summary. This is not a comprehensive community ranking. Likes are net counters, not an approval percentage; downloads are not unique players. Older levels have had more time to accumulate both.

geode.finding: Geode's Texture Loader manages texture packs. Its download counter measures the mod's adoption, not votes for a particular level or pack; it was not used to rank level quality.

designDecisions: Keep the Wave timing and speed/size/gravity/dual variation that motivated the reference search; author original routes, artwork and music.
Give each of the ten courses a different ordered mechanic sequence instead of using duration as a difficulty proxy.
Use large blocks, slalom, moving gates and visible rotating saws; label portals before crossing.
Keep teleport exits visible and leave an exit runway. Never hide lethal obstacles behind decoration.
No full-screen strobing. Optional local portal pulse is off by default. Low effects changes only rendering.
Add optional checkpoint practice; practice does not save a normal clear. Retain three genuinely difficult final courses.

userSuppliedForumSummary.note: The user supplied a summary after reading these threads. Direct web retrieval timed out during this update. Treat it as requested design feedback, not newly verified or statistically representative survey evidence.
